name: Reentrancy / State Update Order Issue
scenario: Function sends ETH or performs a low-level external call while handling user-controlled value.
property: The external call happens before the relevant balance or state update, leaving a reentry window.
static_check: Confirm an external call line appears before a later balance/state update line.

name: Missing Access Control
scenario: Public or external function performs a sensitive owner/admin/mint operation.
property: The function lacks an obvious owner check such as onlyOwner or require(msg.sender == owner).
static_check: Confirm sensitive operation exists and reject if owner check or onlyOwner is present.

name: Risky First Deposit
scenario: Deposit or liquidity function handles the first depositor when total supply or liquidity is zero.
property: Initial shares are set directly from the deposit amount and then minted, allowing share-price manipulation.
static_check: Confirm a totalSupply/supply zero branch and direct amount-to-share minting logic.
